::::

::: notes
Three sentences to take with you. You wrote the estimand behind a published claim, reproduced one of the results recorded for it to the third decimal, and you can say why the other group in this class got another number: different choices about the data, the model and the code, none of them careless. You then became the sixth analyst, varied one decision at a time, put the analysis that you would defend on the class chart, and read your own place among eight hundred and sixty-four justifiable analyses of the same data, which is a publishable way to report a robustness check. And you know what that curve is and is not. It describes every justifiable analysis of the data in hand, and it is only as good as the menu written for it; a test of the whole curve, a declared analysis and a replication on new data are steps that it leaves to others.
:::
